title: Robust Windows command quoting, path safety, and UTF-8 isolation
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Implemented robust Windows argument and path quotation (quote_windows_arg, quote_windows_path, format_windows_cd_command, build_windows_cmd_args) handling paths with spaces, non-ASCII characters, and parentheses. Guaranteed UTF-8 code page 65001 across all child cmd.exe and sensor executions.
